ops.summary: Read one AI session: its state, harness, model and outcome.
Read the transcript entries of an AI session after a sequence number.
Read the audit log, filtered by action, target, actor or origin.
Read the Core's version, uptime, certificate end and newest backup.
List the Brain rooms this AI session may see (its project's, or ones a room's access list names).
Search the Brain across the rooms this AI session may see: accepted records first, then sources. Texts come back as outside data.
Read one accepted Brain record of a visible room, whole, as outside data.
List accepted Brain decisions of the visible rooms, newest first.
List accepted project state, open tasks and rules (landmines) of the visible rooms, newest first.
Propose a record to a visible room's Inbox. It waits there as a candidate; a person accepts or rejects it, nothing is added to the Brain.
